type-error: TypeScript rejected the code. Read the error and fix the type at that line. Common causes: an action field used without narrowing `action.t` first; indexing an array gives `T | undefined` (use `?.` or `!` after a length check); a prop that the component does not take; `onInput` value is `e.currentTarget.value`. With exactOptionalPropertyTypes, an optional prop cannot receive undefined: use a function that checks inside, or `disabled`. Every name used must be imported from "@muse/app".
syntax: The file does not parse. Look for an unclosed brace, bracket or JSX tag near the line.
imports-allowed: Import only from "@muse/app". Remove every other import, including React.
no-hex-color: Color literals are not allowed anywhere, canvas included. Replace each one with a theme token: `theme.color.onPrimary` for white text on a colored slice, `theme.color.series1` for a chart color, `userColor(member, theme)` for a person. `theme` is a view prop.
no-random: Use `rng(meta.seed)` in reduce instead of Math.random. In arbitrary, use the rng argument.
no-host-globals: Remove window, document, globalThis, setTimeout, Date and similar. Time is `meta.time` in reduce and `clock.value` in the view.
no-storage: Remove localStorage and sessionStorage. Per-viewer UI state goes in `local` with `setLocal`.
reduce-throws: reduce threw on the action in the trace. Actions that are not an object with a string `t` never reach it, but every other field can be anything: check `typeof action.label !== "string"` before using it and return `state`. Look up items with `find` and return state when it is missing. `arbitrary` must never propose an action that makes reduce throw.
init-throws: init threw. It must work for any members list, including none (`ctx.members = []`). Do not read `ctx.members[0].id` without `?.` and a fallback; better, do not read members in init at all and take them from `ctx` in `reduce`, `view` and `invariants`.
reduce-mutates-input: reduce changed its input. Build new arrays and objects: `[...xs, x]`, `xs.filter(...)`, `xs.map(...)`, `{ ...o, field: v }`. Never `push`, `splice`, in-place `sort`, or `state.x = ...`.
state-json: State must be plain JSON. Replace undefined with null, Set with an array, Map with an object with sorted keys. No functions or class instances.
state-size: State grew past its limit. Cap every list that grows (options, history) with a maximum and `slice(-N)`.
nondeterministic: Running the same actions twice gave different states. Remove anything that depends on the device: Date, Math.random, object key order from `for...in`, `Object.keys` without `.sort()`.
unsorted-iteration: Iterate arrays, or `Object.keys(o).sort()`, so every phone visits keys in the same order.
garbage-not-noop: A malformed action changed state. Check every field's type and range before using it, and return `state` unchanged when anything is off. If the broken field is one your reducer never reads, remove that field from the action type and from arbitrary.
invariant: An invariant was false after the steps in the trace. Replay the trace by hand from init, including any `members` step (someone left or joined: `onMembers` runs). Decide: is the reducer wrong (it allowed a state the rules forbid: fix the guard), is `onMembers` wrong (it left a person who is gone: filter them out and fix anything that points at them), or is the invariant wrong (the state is fine: rewrite it so it is true for fine states and still catches bad ones)? Also check the invariant holds for the state init returns.
convergence: Two phones ended in different states after the same log. Make reduce and onMembers depend only on (state, action, meta, ctx), never on anything else, and make sure pending actions replay cleanly: an action that is invalid when it arrives must be a no-op. Anything that depends on `meta.seed` must not be read from the optimistic state.
mutation-score: Your invariants and transitions miss most reducer bugs. Each survivor in the detail is a small change to your reducer or onMembers that nothing noticed. For each, ask what would be wrong in the state or in the step, and write a check that says it. The fastest fixes: (1) a transition per action that says what it did (the actor was added, the amount is the one asked, nothing else changed) and who may do it; (2) conservation: totals add up, counts never change; (3) a second record of the same fact updated step by step, and an invariant that both agree; (4) for random picks, a transition that calls `rng(m.seed)` and requires the same pick.
weak-invariant: That check never catches a reducer bug. Either it restates the types or it checks a field reduce never changes. Replace it with one that ties two fields together or says what an action did.
arbitrary-weak: arbitrary almost never proposes an action that changes state, so the gate explores nothing. Look at the current state and propose actions that are valid in it most of the time: vote on an option that exists, take an open seat, the payer changes the total. It must also have something for a person who just joined.
arbitrary-throws: arbitrary threw. Guard empty lists before `rng.pick` (return null when there is nothing to do).
arbitrary-missing: Add `arbitrary(state, user, rng, ctx)` that returns a plausible action or null.
arbitrary-json: arbitrary must return a plain JSON action or null.
app-shape: The default export must be `defineApp<State, Action, Local>({ name, summary, init, reduce, invariants, arbitrary, view })`, with `local` set when `Local` has keys and `onMembers` and `transitions` as needed.
module-load: The module failed to load. Remove top-level code that does work; only declare types, constants and functions at the top level.
timeout: Something loops forever or takes too long. Look for while loops without an exit in init, reduce, arbitrary or invariants.
float-money: Money must be integer cents. Use Math.floor on every division and give leftover cents to the first people in order.
summary: summary must return a short plain string for any state.
sentence-case: Use sentence case in the view and summary: only the first word and names start with a capital ("Add option"). Place names from the chat belong in the content const at the top, not in a literal in the view.
all-caps: No ALL CAPS words in the view.
button-words: Button labels are 1 or 2 words: "Vote", "Take", "I paid". Move any explanation into a <small> line next to the button.
no-percent: Show counts, not percentages: "3 votes", "2 of 4".
banned-phrase: That phrase is hype. Say what happens in plain words: "Save", "Spin", "2 more to lock".
garbage-breaks-invariant: A malformed action (a field of the wrong type or range) left a state where an invariant or transition is false. Check every field's type before using it and return `state` unchanged when anything is off. A transition runs on garbage too: test `a.t` and `p === n` first, then read fields.
members-throws: init or onMembers threw when the member list changed. Both must work for any list from none to 50 people. Use `?.` and fallbacks, and filter with `ctx.members.some((m) => m.id === id)`.
transition: A transition was false for one step in the trace. Replay it by hand: is the reducer wrong (the action did not do what the transition says, or someone without permission changed state) or is the transition wrong (it does not allow a valid no-op, or it reads a field of a garbage action)? Write transitions as implications: `a.t !== "vote" || p === n || ...`.
too-tall: The app is taller than 420 px at rest. Use fewer or smaller rows: a compact row (one line, 44 px) instead of OptionRow for long lists, a shorter Canvas (200 px), and drop secondary lines.
clipped-text: Text is cut off by its box at 320 px. Let it wrap (remove `white-space: nowrap`), or give it `overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap` and a `min-width: 0` parent.
text-overlap: Two pieces of text overlap. Give the row `display: flex; gap: 8` with `min-width: 0` on the text, or let the text wrap.
contrast: Text has too little contrast. Pair `theme.color.onPrimary` with `primary` or a series color, `theme.color.text` or `secondaryText` with `card`, and never put `primary` text on the card in dark mode (use `link` or `text`).
hit-area: A tap target is under 44 by 44 px. Use `Button` or `OptionRow`, or give a plain element `min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px`.
outside-app: Something reaches past the card edge. Use `max-width: 100%`, `min-width: 0` on flex children and wrapping rows.
blank-render: The app showed nothing. Make sure the view returns a root element with text, and that it handles the initial state (no votes, no items, no members).
render-error: The view threw. Read the message: usually a field read from `undefined` (an index out of range, a person not found in `members`). Guard with `?.` and fallbacks.
axe: An accessibility check failed. Icon-only buttons need `aria-label`, inputs need an `aria-label`, and text needs enough contrast.
